exercises.instruction: Choose the correctly reduced relative clause.
exercises.prompt: Full: 'The student who is sleeping in the back row will miss important content.'
options: The student slept in the back row will miss important content.
The student sleeping in the back row will miss important content.
The student sleep in the back row will miss important content.
The student is sleeping in the back row will miss important content.
exercises.answer: The student sleeping in the back row will miss important content.
exercises.explanation: Active continuous → drop 'who is' → leave -ing participle: 'sleeping'.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correctly reduced passive relative clause.
exercises.prompt: Full: 'The samples that were collected from three sites were analysed.'
options: The samples collecting from three sites were analysed.
The samples collected from three sites were analysed.
The samples that collected from three sites were analysed.
The samples being collected from three sites were analysed.
exercises.answer: The samples collected from three sites were analysed.
exercises.explanation: Passive relative clause → drop 'that were' → leave past participle: 'collected'.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct infinitive reduction.
exercises.prompt: Full: 'She was the only researcher who survived the expedition.'
options: She was the only researcher surviving the expedition.
She was the only researcher survived the expedition.
She was the only researcher to survive the expedition.
She was the only researcher that surviving the expedition.
exercises.answer: She was the only researcher to survive the expedition.
exercises.explanation: After 'only' (and first, last, next), use to-infinitive for reduction.

exercises.instruction: Identify the incorrectly reduced clause.
options: The documents submitted last week were approved.
The professor teaching this course has won several awards.
The results obtaining from the experiment were significant.
The first person to arrive received a prize.
exercises.answer: The results obtaining from the experiment were significant.
exercises.explanation: 'Obtaining' suggests the results are actively obtaining something. The correct passive form is 'obtained' — results were obtained (passive).

exercises.instruction: Which clause CANNOT be reduced?
options: The woman who is standing at the door.
The report that was published last month.
The book that I bought yesterday.
The first student who answered correctly.
exercises.answer: The book that I bought yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 'That' is the object of 'bought' (I bought the book). Object relative clauses cannot be reduced — the reduced form 'the book bought' is ambiguous.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct reduced form for an active clause.
exercises.prompt: Full: 'The children who were playing in the park ran home when it started to rain.'
options: The children played in the park ran home when it started to rain.
The children to play in the park ran home when it started to rain.
The children playing in the park ran home when it started to rain.
The children having played in the park ran home when it started to rain.
exercises.answer: The children playing in the park ran home when it started to rain.
exercises.explanation: Active continuous → drop 'who were' → leave -ing participle: 'playing'.

exercises.instruction: Which reduction is correct for the passive clause?
exercises.prompt: Full: 'Proposals that are submitted after the deadline will not be considered.'
options: Proposals submitting after the deadline will not be considered.
Proposals submitted after the deadline will not be considered.
Proposals to submit after the deadline will not be considered.
Proposals that submitted after the deadline will not be considered.
exercises.answer: Proposals submitted after the deadline will not be considered.
exercises.explanation: Passive → drop 'that are' → past participle: 'submitted'. Present passive 'that are submitted' → 'submitted'.

exercises.instruction: Which sentence uses an infinitive reduction correctly?
options: He was the last person leaving the building.
He was the last person left the building.
He was the last person to leave the building.
He was the last person who leaving the building.
exercises.answer: He was the last person to leave the building.
exercises.explanation: After 'last', use to-infinitive: 'the last person to leave'.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct reduced form.
exercises.prompt: Full: 'The language that is spoken in Brazil is Portuguese.'
options: The language speaking in Brazil is Portuguese.
The language spoken in Brazil is Portuguese.
The language to speak in Brazil is Portuguese.
The language speaks in Brazil is Portuguese.
exercises.answer: The language spoken in Brazil is Portuguese.
exercises.explanation: Passive: 'that is spoken' → past participle: 'spoken'. The language doesn't speak — it is spoken.

exercises.instruction: Reduce the relative clause. Write the correct participle form.
exercises.prompt: The man who is standing near the entrance is the security guard. → The man ___ near the entrance is the security guard.
options: did standing
standinging
standings
standing
exercises.answer: standing
exercises.explanation: Active 'who is standing' → drop 'who is' → 'standing' (-ing participle).

exercises.instruction: Reduce the passive clause. Write the correct form.
exercises.prompt: The report that was written by the committee was 50 pages long. → The report ___ by the committee was 50 pages long.
options: did written
writtening
written
writtens
exercises.answer: written
exercises.explanation: Passive 'that was written' → drop 'that was' → past participle 'written'.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer for: the correct infinitive form.
exercises.prompt: She was the first student who answered all questions correctly. → She was the first student ___ all questions correctly.
options: to answer
to answered
answer to
tos answer
exercises.answer: to answer
exercises.hint: Use to-infinitive after 'first, last, only, next'.
exercises.explanation: After 'first', reduce with to-infinitive: 'to answer'.

exercises.instruction: Can this clause be reduced? Write 'yes' or 'no'.
exercises.prompt: The film that she recommended was excellent. Can it be reduced to 'The film recommended was excellent'?
options: noing
did no
nos
no
exercises.answer: no
exercises.hint: Is 'that' the subject or object of 'recommended'?
exercises.explanation: 'That' = object of 'recommended' (she recommended the film). Object clauses cannot be reduced — the meaning becomes ambiguous.

exercises.instruction: Reduce the clause. Write the -ing form.
exercises.prompt: Researchers who are working on this problem face many challenges. → Researchers ___ on this problem face many challenges.
options: workings
working
workinging
did working
exercises.answer: working
exercises.explanation: Active 'who are working' → drop 'who are' → 'working'.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Pria yang duduk di sudut itu adalah direktur."
exercises.prompt: Pria yang duduk di sudut itu adalah direktur.
options: The man sitting in a corner is a director.
The man sitting in the corner was the director.
The man sitting in the corner is the director.
The man sitting in corner is director.
exercises.answer: The man sitting in the corner is the director.
exercises.explanation: 'Yang duduk' (who is sitting) → reduce to 'sitting' (-ing participle).

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Data yang dikumpulkan dari tiga lokasi dianalisis oleh tim peneliti."
exercises.prompt: Data yang dikumpulkan dari tiga lokasi dianalisis oleh tim peneliti.
options: The data collected from three is locationing was analysed by the research team.
The data collected from three locations is analysed by the research team.
The data collected from three locations was analysed by a research team.
The data collected from three locations was analysed by the research team.
exercises.answer: The data collected from three locations was analysed by the research team.
exercises.explanation: 'Yang dikumpulkan' (that was collected) → past participle 'collected' for passive reduction.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Dia adalah orang pertama yang memenangkan penghargaan itu dua kali."
exercises.prompt: Dia adalah orang pertama yang memenangkan penghargaan itu dua kali.
options: She was the first person to win the award twice.
She was a first person to win an award twice.
She is the first person to win the award twice.
she were the first person to win the award twice.
exercises.answer: She was the first person to win the award twice.
exercises.explanation: 'Orang pertama yang' + verb → 'the first person to' + infinitive.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Produk yang dijual di sini semuanya buatan tangan."
exercises.prompt: Produk yang dijual di sini semuanya buatan tangan.
options: Products sold here were all handmade.
handmade. all are here sold Products
Products sold here are all handmade.
is Producting sold here are all handmade.
exercises.answer: Products sold here are all handmade.
exercises.explanation: 'Yang dijual' (that are sold) → passive → past participle 'sold'.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct participle form.
exercises.prompt: The article ___ in Nature last year has been cited over 500 times.
options: publishing
published
to publish
being publish
exercises.answer: published
exercises.explanation: The article was published (passive) → past participle 'published'. The article didn't publish itself.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct participle form.
exercises.prompt: The team ___ the experiment encountered several unexpected problems.
options: conducted
conducting
to conduct
conducted by
exercises.answer: conducting
exercises.explanation: The team actively conducts the experiment → active -ing: 'conducting'. The team = subject doing the action.
